issue: The formal evaluation completed scanner execution, normalization, metrics and safety validation, but artifact publication failed because command-log.txt remained open through a tee process after SHA256SUMS was generated. Reproducibility and evidence checks also executed before harvested outputs existed in the repository.
resolution: Close the finite evaluation logging pipeline before generating and verifying checksums. Select the first successful post-repair formal run on an ancestor of the research branch, harvest its exact artifact, then run reproducibility and evidence consistency only after harvested files are present.
rerun_rule: The first successful formal evaluation run after the PD-002 operational repair is authoritative. Later runs may verify reproducibility but may not replace it based on outcome values.
bias_direction: No expected direction. The repair changes only evidence finalization and workflow ordering; all outcome-producing source, benchmark identity, tool versions, adapters, thresholds, primary comparison, bootstrap seed and tests remain unchanged.
invalidated_execution: Run 30607078461 is invalid as release evidence because no immutable artifact was uploaded, even though its intermediate calculations completed.
required_reporting: Report PD-002, the failed run IDs, the repair commit, the authoritative successful run ID, and an independent raw-to-metric recomputation.
